about_the_game:
ENTER THE ARENA

Runeveil is a roguelike deckbuilder where your strategy isn't just about what you play, but how you sequence it. Step into the shoes of powerful 7 Elemental Mages and travel through various Arenas. Your goal: Complete the 7 Kings' Trials of the 7 Unique Arena, and survive the escalating chaos.

Unlike traditional card games, where you play one card at a time, in Runeveil, you are the architect of your own turn.

MASTER THE SEQUENCE

Combat is a puzzle of destruction. Place your runes (cards) in a specific order, and watch them trigger for a blasting combo!

BREAK THE GAME WITH SYNERGIES

It’s not just about the cards. Collect ancient Relics, use magical Potions, and apply powerful Enchantments to your runes. Stack multipliers, trigger infinite loops, and create a build so powerful that even the Arena Kings tremble.

INFINITE REPLAYABILITY

  • 7 Unique Arenas: Each arena features its own kingdom, distinct enemy types, mini-bosses, and a challenging final Boss.

  • Ascension System: Beating a trial is just the beginning. Unlock higher Ascension levels for each Arena to face difficult modifiers and stronger enemies.

  • Deep Progression:

    • Mage Evolution: Level up your specific elemental mage to unlock unique skill trees.

    • Global Meta-Progression: Earn experience across all runs to unlock a global talent tree that benefits all your characters.

KEY FEATURES

  • Sequence-Based Combat: A fresh take on deckbuilding where placement and order define your damage output.

  • Magical Arsenal: Play as 7 different mages, each with unique mechanics and playstyles.

  • Relic Hunting: Hundreds of relics and items that fundamentally change how your runes interact.

  • Roguelite Depth: No two runs are the same. Procedurally generated trials ensure endless challenges.

High-Stakes Trials: Conquer 7 increasingly difficult trials to prove your worth in the Arena.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

name: Runeveil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 8.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64 Bit Only

short_description: Magic is chaos, order is power! Enter the Arena as an elemental wizard, craft powerful rune chains, and break the game with wild relic synergies. Beat all trials, defeat the Kings, and ascend to godhood.

*languages with full audio support
